title: Get approval to run a temporary entertainment event
what: Get the council's approval before opening a temporary entertainment event to the public on council land or a road, unless it is small (under 50 people, or up to 200 people meeting set standards).

laws.title: Toowoomba Regional Council Subordinate Local Law No. 1.12 (Operation of Temporary Entertainment Events) 2020

sources.title: Toowoomba Regional Council Subordinate Local Law No. 1.12 (Operation of Temporary Entertainment Events) 2020
sources.quote: Section 6(2) of the authorising local law does not apply to the opening to the public, or the preparation for opening to the public, of an entertainment event if—

sources.title: Toowoomba Regional Council Subordinate Local Law No. 1.12 (Operation of Temporary Entertainment Events) 2020
sources.quote: is, or is to be, undertaken on a local government controlled area and the anticipated, or actual, attendance of the public at the entertainment event is less than 50 persons; and

sources.title: Toowoomba Regional Council Subordinate Local Law No. 1.12 (Operation of Temporary Entertainment Events) 2020
sources.quote: Section 6(2) of the authorising local law does not apply to the opening to the public, or the preparation for opening to the public, of an entertainment event if—

triggers.note: opens a temporary entertainment event to the public on council land or a road

reach.condition: if it runs an event of 50 people or more on council land or a road

assessment.summary: Larger temporary events need the council's approval, with venue plans and conditions.

marks.reason: A permit or approval with plans and conditions; the size that triggers it differs by council.
